memberdef.name: XIic_Send10BitAddrByte1
memberdef.initializer: { \ u8 LocalAddr = (u8)((SlaveAddress) >> 7); \ LocalAddr = (LocalAddr & 0xF6) | 0xF0 | (Operation); \ XIic_WriteReg(InstancePtr->BaseAddress, XIIC_DTR_REG_OFFSET, \ (u32) LocalAddr); \ }

briefdescription.para: Sends the first byte of a 10-bit address for reads and writes.

detaileddescription.para: This macro sends the first byte of the address for a 10 bit address during both read and write operations. It takes care of the details to format the address correctly.
address = 1111_0xxD xx = address MSBits D = Tx direction = 0 = write

parameterdescription.para: The address of the slave to send to.
Indicates XIIC_READ_OPERATION or XIIC_WRITE_OPERATION.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_Send10BitAddrByte1(u16 SlaveAddress, u8 Operation)

briefdescription.para: Sends the second byte of a 10-bit address for reads and writes.

parameterdescription.para: The address of the slave to send to.

memberdef.name: XIic_Send7BitAddr
memberdef.initializer: { \ u8 LocalAddr = (u8)(SlaveAddress << 1); \ LocalAddr = (LocalAddr & 0xFE) | (Operation); \ XIic_WriteReg(InstancePtr->BaseAddress, XIIC_DTR_REG_OFFSET, \ (u32) LocalAddr); \ }

briefdescription.para: Sends a 7-bit address for reads and writes.

briefdescription.para: Disables the specified interrupts in the Interrupt Enable register.

detaileddescription.para: This macro disables the specified interrupts in the Interrupt enable register. It is non-destructive in that the register is read and only the interrupts specified is changed.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The interrupts to be disabled.

briefdescription.para: Enables the specified interrupts in the Interrupt Enable register.

briefdescription.para: Clears the specified interrupt in the Interrupt Status register.

detaileddescription.para: This macro clears the specified interrupt in the Interrupt status register. It is non-destructive in that the register is read and only the interrupt specified is cleared. Clearing an interrupt acknowledges it.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The interrupts to be disabled.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_ClearIntr(u32 BaseAddress, u32 InterruptMask)

briefdescription.para: Clears and enables the specified interrupt.

detaileddescription.para: This macro clears and enables the specified interrupt in the Interrupt status and enable registers. It is non-destructive in that the registers are read and only the interrupt specified is modified. Clearing an interrupt acknowledges it.

parameterdescription.para: The base address of the IIC device.
The interrupts to be cleared and enabled.

simplesect.para: C-style signature void XIic_ClearEnableIntr(u32 BaseAddress, u32 InterruptMask)

memberdef.name: XIic_FlushRxFifo
memberdef.initializer: { \ int LoopCnt; \ u8 BytesToRead = XIic_ReadReg(InstancePtr->BaseAddress, \ XIIC_RFO_REG_OFFSET) + 1; \ for(LoopCnt = 0; LoopCnt < BytesToRead; LoopCnt++) \ { \ XIic_ReadReg(InstancePtr->BaseAddress, \ XIIC_DRR_REG_OFFSET); \ } \ }

detaileddescription.para: This macro flushes the receive FIFO such that all bytes contained within it are discarded.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the IIC instance containing the FIFO to be flushed.
